<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $redis;
    private $serviceName;
    private $failureThreshold;
    private $recoveryTimeout;
    private $halfOpenMaxAttempts;

    const STATE_CLOSED = 'closed';
    const STATE_OPEN = 'open';
    const STATE_HALF_OPEN = 'half_open';

    public function __construct($redis, string $serviceName, int $failureThreshold = 5, int $recoveryTimeout = 30, int $halfOpenMaxAttempts = 3) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->serviceName = $serviceName;
        $this->failureThreshold = $failureThreshold;
        $this->recoveryTimeout = $recoveryTimeout;
        $this->halfOpenMaxAttempts = $halfOpenMaxAttempts;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        $state = $this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state");
        if ($state === false) {
            return self::STATE_CLOSED;
        }
        if ($state === self::STATE_OPEN) {
            $openedAt = (int)$this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:opened_at");
            if (time() - $openedAt >= $this->recoveryTimeout) {
                $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state", self::STATE_HALF_OPEN);
                $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:half_open_count");
                return self::STATE_HALF_OPEN;
            }
        }
        return $state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $state = $this->getState();
        if ($state === self::STATE_HALF_OPEN) {
            $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state", self::STATE_CLOSED);
            $this->redis->del("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        }
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $failures = $this->redis->incr("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        if ($failures >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:state", self::STATE_OPEN);
            $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:opened_at", time());
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        $state = $this->getState();
        if ($state === self::STATE_CLOSED) {
            return true;
        }
        if ($state === self::STATE_HALF_OPEN) {
            $count = $this->redis->incr("cb:{$this->serviceName}:half_open_count");
            return $count <= $this->halfOpenMaxAttempts;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class DistributedRateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $windowSize;
    private $maxRequests;
    private $localCounters;
    private $localTimestamps;

    public function __construct($redis, CircuitBreaker $cb, int $windowSize = 60, int $maxRequests = 100) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->windowSize = $windowSize;
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->localCounters = [];
        $this->localTimestamps = [];
    }

    private function getLocalFallbackDecision(string $clientId): bool {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->localTimestamps[$clientId]) || 
            ($now - $this->localTimestamps[$clientId]) >= $this->windowSize) {
            $this->localCounters[$clientId] = 0;
            $this->localTimestamps[$clientId] = $now;
        }
        $this->localCounters[$clientId]++;
        return $this->localCounters[$clientId] <= $this->maxRequests;
    }

    private function syncToRedis(string $clientId, int $count): void {
        $key = "ratelimit:{$clientId}";
        $this->redis->incrBy($key, $count);
        $this->redis->expire($key, $this->windowSize);
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $clientId): bool {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return $this->getLocalFallbackDecision($clientId);
        }

        try {
            $key = "ratelimit:{$clientId}";
            $current = $this->redis->get($key);
            
            if ($current === false) {
                $this->redis->setex($key, $this->windowSize, 1);
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
                return true;
            }

            $currentCount = (int)$current;
            if ($currentCount < $this->maxRequests) {
                $this->redis->incr($key);
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
                return true;
            }

            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return false;

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return $this->getLocalFallbackDecision($clientId);
        }
    }

    public function getRemainingQuota(string $clientId): int {
        try {
            $key = "ratelimit:{$clientId}";
            $current = (int)$this->redis->get($key);
            $remaining = $this->maxRequests - $current;
            return max(0, $remaining);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

class RateLimitMiddleware {
    private $limiter;
    private $trustProxy;

    public function __construct(DistributedRateLimiter $limiter, bool $trustProxy = false) {
        $this->limiter = $limiter;
        $this->trustProxy = $trustProxy;
    }

    public function getClientIdentifier(): string {
        if ($this->trustProxy && isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'])) {
            $ips = explode(',', $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR']);
            return trim($ips[0]);
        }
        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
    }

    public function handle(): bool {
        $clientId = $this->getClientIdentifier();
        $allowed = $this->limiter->isAllowed($clientId);
        
        if (!$allowed) {
            http_response_code(429);
            header('Retry-After: 60');
            return false;
        }

        $remaining = $this->limiter->getRemainingQuota($clientId);
        header("X-RateLimit-Remaining: {$remaining}");
        return true;
    }
}
